title: Martin, But He Gains 1000 ELO If He Captures or Checks
summary: 'Hungry Martin': Martin gains 1000 Elo every time he captures a piece or puts the player in check. Game 1: Martin starts at 250; player develops the queen early and grabs material, keeps pieces back to avoid random captures, and wins with a promotion checkmate. Game 2: Martin starts at 1250 (same +1000 per capture/check, capped at 3600); player wins a piece but Martin climbs to 2250, 3250, then max 3600 through trades; game ends in a draw after the player sacrifices material.
rules: Standard chess, player white vs Martin.
Game 1: Martin starts at 250 Elo; Game 2: Martin starts at 1250 Elo.
Every time Martin captures any piece or gives check, his Elo increases by 1000.
Elo is capped at 3600 (video: 'bump up its Elo to the max of 3600').
Recaptures in trades count (each Martin capture = +1000).
win_condition: Checkmate Martin. Video: game 1 win (promotion checkmate), game 2 draw.
